content.value_statement: Monitoring teams need dashboards that show useful signals without noise. This skill helps create Grafana dashboards with panels, alerts, variables, and provisioning examples.
actual_capabilities: Explains RED and USE methods for dashboard metric selection.
Provides API, infrastructure, database, and application dashboard patterns.
Shows Grafana panel examples for stat, graph, table, and heatmap views.
Includes Prometheus query examples for rates, errors, latency, and service filters.
Documents dashboard variables, alert blocks, and file provisioning examples.
Covers Terraform and Ansible approaches for dashboard-as-code workflows.
limitations: Does not connect to a live Grafana instance or deploy dashboards by itself.
Prometheus metric names must be adapted to each environment.
Grafana panel schema details may need updates for newer Grafana versions.
Only SKILL.md is present, so referenced asset files are not included.

use_cases.title: Create service health dashboards
use_cases.description: Design dashboards for request rate, error rate, latency, and alert thresholds.

use_cases.title: Standardize infrastructure monitoring
use_cases.description: Plan node, pod, disk, memory, network, and namespace panels with consistent layouts.

use_cases.title: Prepare dashboard-as-code rollouts
use_cases.description: Use provisioning guidance to manage Grafana dashboard files through Terraform or Ansible.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic dashboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one monitored service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Grafana dashboard plan for my API service. Include request rate, error rate, and p95 latency panels.

prompt_templates.title: Add variables and filters
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate dashboard with namespace and service selection.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Grafana dashboard variables for namespace and service filters. Show how the panels should use those variables.

prompt_templates.title: Plan alert coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this dashboard goal and propose alert rules for high error rate, high latency, and missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Build a dashboard-as-code workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for versioned dashboard provisioning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a dashboard-as-code rollout plan for Grafana. Include file layout, Terraform or Ansible steps, and review checks.

output_examples.input: I need an API monitoring dashboard for Prometheus HTTP metrics.
output_examples.output: A dashboard outline with panels for request rate, error percentage, p95 latency, service filters, and alert guidance.

output_examples.input: I need infrastructure views for Kubernetes nodes and pods.
output_examples.output: A monitoring plan covering CPU, memory, disk, network, pod count, node status, and namespace grouping.

output_examples.input: I want to manage Grafana dashboards through source control.
output_examples.output: A provisioning approach with dashboard files, folder organization, deployment tooling, and validation steps before rollout.

best_practices: Start with the most important service or resource signals before adding detailed panels.
Use consistent names, units, colors, thresholds, and time ranges across dashboards.
Test dashboards with several time ranges and realistic production data.
anti_patterns: Do not create dashboards that mix unrelated services without clear grouping.
Do not rely on raw metric names without descriptions or business context.
Do not copy queries without checking label names, units, and cardinality impact.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy dashboards to Grafana?
faq.answer: No. It provides dashboard design and provisioning guidance, but deployment requires your Grafana tooling.

faq.question: Which data source does the skill focus on?
faq.answer: The examples focus on Prometheus metrics and common Grafana dashboard patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with alerts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes alert structure examples and guidance for error rate, latency, and no-data conditions.

faq.question: Can I use it with Terraform?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes a Terraform workflow for managing Grafana dashboard files and folders.

faq.question: Are referenced asset files included?
faq.answer: No. This package only contains SKILL.md, so referenced asset paths are documentation references.

faq.question: Does it cover SLO dashboards?
faq.answer: It supports SLO dashboard planning through RED metrics, latency percentiles, error rates, and alert thresholds.
